title: [Core] Lesson Calendar divider - Dragging blue divider does not resize panels
description: LT-111303 - Bug Reproduction + Negative Testing - The blue vertical divider between Student panel and Calendar is a static visual border and cannot resize either panel.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ/CM Staff in Salesforce. Open Lesson Calendar page. Student panel is visible with Student List expanded or at least one student row visible. Calendar panel is visible in Daily view with at least one lesson or empty grid. Browser viewport is desktop width where Student panel, divider, Calendar panel, and right detail panel area can be displayed.
steps_actions: 1. Open Salesforce Lesson Calendar for a location/date where the Student panel is visible. 2. Record the Student panel width, Calendar panel left edge, and Calendar panel width. 3. Move the mouse over the blue vertical divider between the Student panel and Calendar panel. 4. Mouse down on the blue divider, drag at least 120 px to the right, and release. 5. Record the same panel measurements. 6. Repeat mouse down on the blue divider, drag at least 120 px to the left, and release.
steps_result: 1. Lesson Calendar loads with Student panel, static blue divider, and Calendar panel displayed. 2. Baseline measurements are captured. 3. Divider does not show resize behavior or any visible draggable handle state. 4. No panel resize happens while dragging and no layout jump occurs after release. 5. Student panel width, Calendar panel left edge, and Calendar panel width remain unchanged within 2 px tolerance. 6. Measurements still remain unchanged within 2 px tolerance; Student panel and Calendar panel do not overlap.
steps_data: 1. page = Lesson Calendar; view = Daily; student_panel = expanded. 2. capture = studentPanel.width, calendarPanel.x, calendarPanel.width. 3. target = blue divider. 4. drag_delta_x = +120. 5. tolerance = 2px. 6. drag_delta_x = -120.
suite: Static Student Panel Divider on Lesson Calendar (LT-111303)

title: [Core] Lesson Calendar divider - Calendar view filters and detail drawer remain stable

preconditions: Logged in as HQ/CM Staff in Salesforce. Open Lesson Calendar for a location/date with at least one visible lesson. Student panel is visible. User can switch between Daily and Weekly view and open the filter panel/detail drawer.
steps_actions: 1. Open Lesson Calendar Daily view and attempt to drag the blue divider. 2. Search or filter the Student List by a student name. 3. Click a visible lesson card to open the right-side lesson detail panel. 4. Switch Calendar view from Daily to Weekly. 5. Attempt to drag the blue divider again in Weekly view. 6. steps_result: 1. Divider drag does not resize panels; Daily calendar grid remains usable. 2. Student List filters normally inside the left panel and the panel width does not change unexpectedly. 3. Right-side lesson detail panel opens; Student panel, divider, Calendar panel, and detail panel do not overlap. 4. Weekly view loads and retains correct layout. 5. Divider drag still does not resize panels in Weekly view. 6. Filter applies and clears normally; Calendar results update without horizontal overflow or clipped grid.
steps_data: 1. view = Daily; target = blue divider. 2. search_keyword = existing student name. 3. lesson = visible lesson card. 4. view = Weekly. 5. target = blue divider. 6. filter = any available lesson status/type.

title: [Core] Lesson Calendar divider - Layout remains aligned after browser resize and zoom

steps_data: 1. viewport_width = 1500. 2. tolerance = 2px. 3. viewport_width = 1280 or zoom = 90%. 4. expected_overflow = none. 5. action = collapse then expand. 6. target = blue divider.
